shape.description: A `list` of integers, a `tuple` of integers, or a 1-D `Tensor` of type `int32`.

dtype.description: Optional DType of an element in the resulting `Tensor`. Default is `tf.float32`.

layout.description: Optional, `tf.experimental.dtensor.Layout`. If provided, the result is a [DTensor](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/dtensor_overview) with the provided layout.

output.description: A `Tensor` with all elements set to one (1).
